summary.text: S.G. Goodman's audience—drawn to authentic, narrative-rich storytelling with Southern Gothic and evocative depth—clusters strongest in Nashville, Cincinnati, Asheville, Louisville, and Indianapolis. This five-city route follows Qloo's room-affinity rankings to reach fans of folk, blues, and country-rooted narratives across the Southeast and Midwest.

theme.text: Southern Narratives: A deep dive into storytelling rooted in place, loss, and resilience—invite fans to share their own stories via a pre-show listening station or post-show open forum.
Intimate & Authentic: Strip-back acoustic nights or album-playthrough series that emphasize the narrative richness and empathetic core of each song.

Evocative Visuals: Stage design or projection featuring Southern Gothic imagery, archival photographs, or fan-submitted personal narratives to reinforce the evocative, emotionally resonant atmosphere.

merch.text: Vinyl reissues or limited-edition albums packaged with printed lyric booklets or personal liner notes exploring the stories behind each song.
Branded Stetson or Tecovas collaborations—hats or western wear reflecting the aesthetic of fans who favour Authentic and Southern Gothic tastes.
Limited zines or photo books featuring archival imagery, storytelling essays, or production notes tied to films like Blaze or The Fabelmans that resonate with this audience.

risks.text: Qloo affinity reflects taste alignment, not confirmed ticket demand or turnout. Room holds and promoter capacity are unconfirmed.
Five-city routing assumes no competing shows or logistical conflicts; confirm dates and venue availability directly with each booker.
Opener suggestions are based on shared-taste data; confirm availability and fit with each venue independently before announcing partnerships.
